title: Ruin Hold
hook: Hold a moonlit ruin with friends: two waves of the risen dead come up out of the graves, and their captain comes last.
prompt: a small first-person co-op fight with weight: friends hold a ruin at night against skeletons rising from the graves, two waves and then their captain

round.winBy: Hold the ruin through both waves.

props.name: chest
props.describe: an iron-bound chest the dead come for

rules.summary: The dead rise from the graves of a moonlit ruin in two waves, the second led by a brute of a captain. Shoot, cut and dodge. With friends, a fallen hunter is brought back: hold E beside them. Shift evades, V is a quick cut, R reloads.
rules.scoring: each kill scores the enemy's points to whoever landed it, and each coin a point to whoever it reaches

characters.describe: you, seen in first person; friends see a hunter in your colour

content.notes: Skeletons fight and break apart; no blood.

accept: the dead rise from the graves and come for you in two waves, more of them in the second
each kill scores for whoever landed it, and the round is won when both waves are cleared
with friends, a fallen hunter is brought back by a friend holding E beside them
Play again starts a new hold
notInV1: rewards between waves (cards or a shop)
